concerns.text: FR-004 requires comparing 'the generated execution plan' against ground truth, but no task implements the SUT/router plan generator. T024 says 'Binary translation-error comparison (FR-004) in code/analysis/metrics.py against T007 ground truth' — an implementer has no producer for the other side of the comparison, so translation_error cannot be computed. Add a task implementing the simulated router/SUT plan generator (spec Assumption: 'unified router logic is simulated using a lightweight Python script') with a concrete file path and test.

T013 requires a contract test for the ExecutionMetric schema, but that schema mandates mismatch_flag, delta_latency, engine_version, and throttle_config — fields no task produces and absent from execution_logs.csv. The test is unexecutable as specified: either the schema must be reconciled with the execution_log contract or T013 must name which fields it validates and where they are produced.

data-model.md states generation_log.json is 'Validated by contracts/generation_log.schema.yaml' and the plan lists anova_results.schema.yaml, but T004 creates neither; no task produces or validates these two schemas, so the intermediate SSoT artifact has no checkable contract. Also analysis_result.schema.yaml (required by T004) demands mean_delta_latency/std_delta_latency/segmented_regression_knee_point and per-group rows that no task outputs — T018 writes the different anova_results.json structure from data-model.md.

T005 specifies 'DBpedia/Wikidata subset via a named, reachable source' — the source is not actually named, so an implementer cannot deterministically pick the dataset or its loading recipe. Name the exact dataset id/URL and loading call, as is done for MS MARCO and Spider.

No task defines the composition of the 500-query set (per source type × depth 1–4) or the 100 high-complexity graph queries required by US-2 scenario 2. T021 only requires ≥30 sample queries; T037 says 'complete 500-query set' without a partition spec. Add the exact per-cell query counts (e.g., in T006/T017 config) so T037 is verifiable.

T036 says 'Add unit tests for generator edge cases in tests/unit/' without exact file/test names, unlike T013/T014. Name the test file and the specific test functions (depth-cap warning, timeout-as-outlier, main.py timeout enforcement) so completion is checkable.

T027 'Validation that ground-truth plans originate from the independent reference engine (FR-008, non-circular)' names no artifact, file path, or verification method. Specify what is produced (e.g., a test in tests/unit/ asserting ground_truth_plan equals reference_engine output and that the SUT generator does not import it) — as written it is not executable.

plan.md specifies a flat code/ layout (query_generator.py, ground_truth_engine.py, stats.py, visualize.py) while tasks use code/generators/, code/executors/, code/analysis/ with different filenames. Tasks are internally self-contained, but an implementer consulting plan.md will create files no task references; add a note in T001 that the tasks.md layout supersedes plan.md's sketch, or reconcile the plan.
